title: finding(changeset): pending changeset bodies state in the present tense what a schema declares, and a later card's merge silently falsifies them — `8802` is already false for `columns` and the precedent is `left uncorrected`
body:
Dedup keywords: pending changeset · present-tense claim · `declares none of them` · changeset-claim-re-read · falsified by a later merge

Surfaced by the `os-dev` delivering objectui#9606 (PR objectui#9709) and **both instances re-verified on `origin/main` by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat before filing**. ⛔ Filed as a `finding`; grading, `domain:*` and routing are the triage seat's.

Sibling of objectui#9706, which is the same family reached by a different trigger (a claim about another **PR's state**). This card is about claims a later card's **merge** falsifies.

## The class

A pending `.changeset/*.md` body states, in the present tense, what a schema declares. A **later, unrelated** card then declares that key. The changeset is never revisited, and it publishes verbatim into the CHANGELOG at the next release. Nothing assigns anyone to correct it: the card that falsifies it is not the card that wrote it.

## Instance 1 — already false on `main` today, with no help from any open PR

`.changeset/8802-8257-8008-kanban-gantt-family-retirement.md:61`:

> *"... `draggable` / `onColumnAdd` / `onCardAdd` by name, and — through `columns: KanbanColumn[]` — the only one that judged a lane's `cards`. **The surviving `ObjectKanbanSchema` face declares none of them.**"*

Measured on `origin/main`, inside the `ObjectKanbanSchema` body:

| key named by that sentence | declared on `ObjectKanbanSchema` today? |
|---|---|
| `columns` | **YES** — `z.union([z.array(z.string()), z.array(ObjectKanbanLaneSchema)]).optional()` |
| `cardTitle` | not yet on `main`; **declared on PR objectui#9709's head** |

Controls: lit — `groupBy` reads 1 on that same arm, so the arm-scoped probe fires; absent — a nonsense key reads 0.

⇒ The sentence is **already false for `columns`**, and objectui#8913 is the card that made it so. ⭐ **That card declared `columns` and did not correct this sentence** — so the established precedent on this exact class is *left uncorrected*, and objectui#9709 would be the second instance rather than the first.

⚠️ The same paragraph says declaring these keys on `ObjectKanbanSchema` *"would WIDEN a published accept set, which is a maintainer ruling and not part of this one"* — which is precisely the ruling that authorised objectui#9606. So the changeset correctly predicted a ruling would be needed, the ruling happened, and the prediction's own text was left behind as a false statement.

## Instance 2 — stale three times over

`.changeset/7322-object-kanban-component-props.md:22`, a read-set census bullet:

> *"- `columns`, `cardTitle`, `swimlaneField`, `grouping` — `KanbanSchema` only;"*

| reading on `origin/main` | |
|---|---|
| `export const KanbanSchema` in `complex.zod.ts` / `objectql.zod.ts` | **0** — the bare arm was retired by objectui#8802 |
| lit control — `export const ObjectKanbanSchema` | **1** ⇒ instrument connected |

⇒ the bullet attributes keys to a schema that **no longer exists**, and two of the four keys it names are now on the surviving arm (`columns` today, `cardTitle` on objectui#9709).

⚠️ ⛔ This is **not** the `:47` line of the same file (*"`cardTitle` (already declared; the casts were redundant)"*), which this seat checked earlier and found correct — that one is genuinely about `KanbanSchema`, the retired arm, and is a historical statement rather than a present-tense one. The two look alike and only one moves.

## ⭐ Why the existing gate does not catch this

`check-changeset-claims` / `changeset-claim-re-read` matched **22** pending changesets against PR objectui#9709 by **filename resolution** — it asks whether a pending body names a file the diff touches. Neither instance above is among those 22, because neither names `objectql.ts` or `zod/objectql.zod.ts` in backticks; they name a **schema** (`ObjectKanbanSchema`, `KanbanSchema`) instead.

⇒ the gate's own stated limit — *"judges name resolution, never meaning"* — has a second edge nobody has written down: a claim **about a symbol** is invisible to it even when the symbol lives in a file the diff edits. The claims most likely to go false this way are exactly the ones it cannot see.

⛔ Not a proposed gate change. Recording the blind spot is the finding; whether to close it is a decision.

## What this card asks for

1. Decide who owns correcting a pending changeset that a **later** card falsifies — the falsifying card, the original author's lane, or a sweep. Today the answer is nobody, and objectui#8913 is the precedent for that.
2. Decide the disposition of these two bodies before the next release. They publish verbatim; objectui#9706 records that a release PR (objectui#5400) is open right now with the sibling class already staged into `packages/types/CHANGELOG.md`.

⛔ Nothing was repaired here: both bodies are other cards' published text, and PR objectui#9709's dev correctly named them and declined to edit them.
